name: ovos-audio-transformer-plugin-omva-voiceid
description: A plugin for the Open Voice OS (OVOS) that provides voice identification capabilities using the OMVA model.
author: ecosphereplus

setup_notes.heading: Installation
setup_notes.content:
### Standard Installation

pip install -e .

### Standalone Service

The plugin can run as a standalone service:

setup_notes.heading: Configuration
setup_notes.content:
Add to your OVOS configuration:

{
    "listener": {
        "audio_transformers": {
            "ovos-audio-transformer-plugin-omva-voiceid": {
                "enabled": true,
                "model": "speechbrain/spkrec-ecapa-voxceleb",
                "model_cache_dir": "/opt/omva/speechbrain_cache",
                "sample_rate": 16000,
                "confidence_threshold": 0.8,
                "processing_timeout_ms": 100,
                "gpu": false,
                "enable_enrollment": true,
                "enrollment_session_timeout": 600,
                "sample_timeout": 30,
                "min_quality_threshold": 0.5,
                "min_sample_duration": 2.0,
                "max_sample_duration": 10.0,
                "enrollment": {
                    "min_samples": 3…
